messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: node cluster-us-west-2a-07 is reporting ephemeral storage pressure >= 95% and multiple pod evictions. Impact: several serve-runtime pods restarted. Rule: ephemeral.disk.eviction.high

oncall-sre: Seeing repeated evictions on modelcache pods (serve-runtime). Pods get evicted, restart, then crash with CUDA init errors. Paging in to confirm whether this is widespread.

raj: Logs from pod serve-runtime-abc-0 show repeated OOMs and kernel messages. snippet below:
```
[2026-03-15T18:02:11Z] serve-runtime: ERROR: model cache write failed: no space left on device
[2026-03-15T18:02:13Z] runtime: cudaInit failed: out of memory
[2026-03-15T18:02:13Z] runtime: process killed by SIGABRT after OOM on device 0
```

maria: Confirmed: node tmp usage at 98% and journal logs huge (~40GB). Seems recent log rotation/config failed. Also some checkpoint uploads in progress.

eng-runtime-lead: Repro on my side: when modelcache tries to write a checkpoint and disk fills, KV cache becomes corrupt and runtime panics. Need immediate mitigation: reduce logging, stop non-critical uploads, and free space.

infra-ops: I'm cordoning the node and draining non-critical pods now. Command: `kubectl cordon cluster-us-west-2a-07 && kubectl drain cluster-us-west-2a-07 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data`

support-lucy: Customer impact: support queue shows 7 customers reporting 500s for text generation and 12 customers with timeouts. CS dashboard: higher error rate for endpoints using /v1/generate on models rdx-small/rx-medium. Marking major-impact for now.

oncall-sre: Quick mitigation checklist: 1) stop model cache checkpointing on node 2) remove old logs under /var/log/serve 3) restart kubelet if stuck 4) scale down modelcache replicas to reduce writes

eng-runtime-lead: Patching runtime to skip checkpoint writes when available disk < 5% is the longer-term fix. For now run: 
```sh
# kill the checkpoint job for node
kubectl -n infra delete job modelcache-checkpoint-node-07 || true
# cleanup large logs
sudo du -sh /var/log/serve/* | sort -h | tail -n 10
sudo rm -f /var/log/serve/old-* || true
```

raj: Also found this in pod logs right before crash: `ERROR[ckpt] failed to flush: write: no space left on device` -> then CUDA stack trace and container OOM kill. So freeing space should stop cascade.

customer-success: Noted major accounts impacted: acct-omega and acct-lumen seeing degraded performance. Reached out via priority channel and opened status page entry.

oncall-sre: Doing stepwise: cordon done, non-critical pods drained, removing 28GB of archived logs now. I see disk drop from 98% -> 68% on node. Recreating pods for critical customers only.

support-lucy: Errors dropping on support tickets after node drain. Some requests still hitting degraded nodes in the fallback pool; adding routing rule to avoid cluster-us-west-2a-07.

eng-runtime-lead: Recommend disabling aggressive debug logging for serve-runtime on the affected release: set env SERVE_LOG_LEVEL=info and rollout patch:
```yaml
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: serve-runtime
spec:
  template:
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: runtime
        env:
        - name: SERVE_LOG_LEVEL
          value: "info"
```
kubectl apply -f patch.yaml --namespace=serve
```

infra-ops: Node uncordon will wait until kubelet mem/disk checks pass. We should also add a cronjob to prune /var/log/serve older than 7 days across nodes. I'll file infra ticket.

maria: Handoff to next oncall (maria) — oncall-sre handing off with: node cordoned, 28GB cleared, modelcache checkpoint job deleted, routing rule in place, customer-impact notified. Watchdog set to 30m to verify no further evictions.

maria: Taking over. I'll keep an eye for replays and kick off a cluster-wide scan for nodes with >80% tmp usage. Also will escalate to SRE pager if we see another eviction wave.

customer-success: Keeping customers updated; status page updated with "investigating - storage pressure caused serving errors". Will send follow-up once nodes stable.

oncall-sre: Final notes before sleep: create postmortem ticket, include root cause hypothesis: logrot/config bug + checkpoint traffic, mitigation: cron prune, limit checkpoint frequency, runtime guard for low-disk, and routing fallback improvements. Assign owners: eng-runtime (guard + logging), infra (cron + alerts), cs (customer comms). :thumbsup:

support-lucy: Confirmed alerting threshold lowered for ephemeral usage to 85% cluster-wide and added runbook link in alert.

maria: I'll run quick smoke: 10 test requests to affected endpoints -> all green from fallback pool. Monitoring for 2 hours. If stable, we'll close incident and spawn follow-ups.

incident-bot: Incident updated: status=mitigated, severity=high, assigned=eng-runtime, infra-ops, customer-success, incident_link=https://redwood.incidents/4281009876

maria: closing handoff thread, moving to postmortem doc creation. Thanks everyone for fast responses :heart:
